name: Question authoring
description: From one portal section's pages as ingested, write benchmark question rows a second person reviews: en/uk twins with identical verbatim gold, negatives without gold, closed ids and categories. On a second pass rewrite only the rows the validator failed.

human_review.notes: Owner review 2026-11-02 11:26: APPROVED 019 UAT-3 S5 — SKILL.md read at the S5 UAT-3 gate; en/uk twins with identical verbatim gold, negatives without gold, closed ids and categories, second pass rewrites only the failing rows.

section.description: The portal section the rows belong to (`guide/chat`, `technical`, …).

pages.description: The section's pages as ingested — route and text (bounded). Gold phrases are copied from `text`.

max_rows.description: The ceiling for the batch (twins count as two rows).

failing_rows.description: Second pass only: the rows the validator failed, each with `problems[]` — rewrite these alone, same ids.

gold_facts.description: Verbatim phrases of the gold page (the English text, for both twins). Empty for a negative.

gold_pages.description: Routes inside the section. Empty for a negative.

examples.title: A first pass on a short section

pages.text:
# NexTasks

NexTasks is the suite's work app. A board holds work items in columns; the Inbox shows the approvals waiting for you. Press ⌘⏎ to approve the open card. Only a project owner can archive a board.
